# has prohibition

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasProhibition`](gmeow-hasProhibition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasProhibition>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
